transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Lucy. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hello Lucy, main Anjali Brown bol rahi hoon. Mera current plan nahi chal raha hai, it is too expensive and I need to change it to a cheaper one.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are finding the current plan expensive, Anjali. I can certainly help you with a plan change.
Customer: Haan, please check karo. My number is 97647 54893. I want the basic plan with 2GB data per day.
Agent: Let me check the options for you. Yes, the basic plan is available for your account.
Customer: Theek hai, please change it now. I don't want to pay extra money every month.
Agent: I have updated your account. The new monthly price will be 499 rupees and the change takes effect from the 1st of next month.
Customer: Wait, 499? Maine toh suna tha it was 399. Why is it so expensive still?
Agent: That is the standard rate for the basic plan. I cannot change the price further.
Customer: Yeh toh bahut galat hai! I am very disappointed with your service. You people always confuse the customer.
Agent: I understand your frustration, but this is the price listed on our website. I will process the plan change and send a confirmation SMS to your phone.
Customer: SMS toh theek hai, but I am not happy with this price. This is totally unfair!
Agent: Is there anything else I can help you with today? I have processed the change and you will receive the SMS shortly. Goodbye!
